guildOnly: Use this command inside a server.

ops.noPermission: You don't have access to this operation. Who can use each one is set in the dashboard, under **Permissions › FiveM**.
ops.backendDown: The backend didn't respond. Try again in a moment.
ops.notLinked: This member never linked their Discord account to FiveM, so there's no way to know which player they are.
ops.planTitle: Feature not included in the plan
ops.plan: This specific command requires a higher plan. The rest of the moderation is still available.
ops.cooldown: You can use this command again in **{seconds}s**.
ops.rateLimit: Too many operations this minute. Try again in a moment.
ops.expired: The FiveM server didn't pick up the command in time — it's probably offline or the `mri-botcreator` resource isn't running. **The action was not applied.**
ops.unconfirmed: The server didn't confirm in time. The action **may** have been applied — check in game before repeating the command.
ops.waitingServer: Waiting for the server to respond.

link.guildOnly: Use this command inside the server where FiveM is set up.
link.codeDescription: The 4-letter code shown when you joined the server.
link.done: Your Discord account was linked to license `{license}`. Rejoin the FiveM server if you're still on the waiting screen: you'll get in automatically.

unlink.noPermission: You don't have permission to unlink accounts.
unlink.nothing: {user} has no FiveM link on this server.
unlink.done: Removed {count, plural, one {# link} other {# links}} from {user}. They can run `{command}` again on their next connection.

confirm.teleportAll: This will teleport **all online players** at once.
confirm.kickall: This will **kick all online players** from the server.
confirm.resourceStop: This will **stop** the resource `{name}`. If it's essential, the server may go down.
confirm.resourceRestart: This will **restart** the resource `{name}`. If it's essential, the server may go down.
confirm.reviveAll: This will revive **all online players**, including those in a scene.
confirm.permission: This changes the permission **in the gamemode**, not through the Discord role — the value may be overwritten when the player reconnects.

mod.allowlistOff:

pd.waitingServer: Waiting for the server to respond.

ban.kicked: They were online and were removed from the server.
